targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS time, kind AS metric, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS value
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind IN ('auth.login', 'auth.denied')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sessions started in the range without a session.end yet.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT count(*) AS active FROM (
  SELECT session_id FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind IN ('session.start', 'session.end') AND session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY session_id HAVING count_if(kind = 'session.end') = 0
)

panels.title: Active sessions

panels.description: People and bots (ADR-0019). Events without an actor_type are people's.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS time, coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') AS metric, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS value
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions by actor

panels.description: CI jobs, by the repository or project that ran them, with the latest run.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT coalesce(data.ci.repository, data.ci.project_path, "user") AS source, "user" AS bot, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_session, max_by(data.ci.run_id, from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_run
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND data.actor_type = 'bot'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Bot sessions by repository

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT data.kind AS kind, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT "user", coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') AS actor, data.resource AS resource, data.login AS login, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_access
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY last_access DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_seen, coalesce("user", '(unknown)') AS "user", data.action AS action,
  data.resource AS resource, data.login AS login, data.reason AS reason, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS attempts
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'auth.denied'
GROUP BY 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT "user", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND "user" IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') = 'user'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Commands as root, or using sudo, su, or other privilege-changing tools.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT from_iso8601_timestamp("time") AS time, "user", data.login AS login, data.resource AS resource, data.command AS command, session_id
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'ssh.exec'
  AND (data.login = 'root' OR regexp_like(data.command, '(^|[;&|[:space:]])(sudo|su|doas|pkexec|chmod|chown|passwd|useradd|usermod|visudo)([[:space:]]|$)'))
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Privileged commands

panels.description: Seconds since each producer's newest event reached the audit store. A growing value means its events aren't arriving.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT producer.component AS component, producer.instance_id AS instance,
  to_unixtime(current_timestamp) - to_unixtime(max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time"))) AS lag_seconds
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC

panels.title: Ingestion lag by producer

panels.description: Each producer numbers its events. Gaps mean lost events and should always be zero (ADR-0009).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT producer.instance_id AS instance, min(producer.seq) AS first_seq, max(producer.seq) AS last_seq,
  max(producer.seq) - min(producer.seq) + 1 - count(DISTINCT producer.seq) AS missing
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY missing DESC

panels.title: Missing events (sequence gaps)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT from_iso8601_timestamp("time") AS time, "user" AS author, data.version AS version, data.digest AS digest, data.source_ref AS source_ref
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime($__timeFrom(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime($__timeTo(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'policy.change'
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50
